Nominal equipment envelopes and rack inlet-side markers, aisle-end sheets/roof outlines and floor tiles are derived from the saved schema. HAC ceiling-return and vertical duct footprints are schematic projections. All panels share world X/Z coordinates and scale. Geometry and equipment parameters retain synthetic/mock provenance; these normal references are not independent training seeds, optimized designs, or simulated flow fields.
